title: Outbox, inbox và unknown external effects
scope_items: Canonical Goose SQL migration (infra/migrations/00002_p0_05_outbox_inbox_external_effects.sql) creating consumer_inbox (§26.6), external_effects (§26.8), diagnostics_records (§13.4), dead_letter_queue (§18.4G), background_jobs (§18.4D), and api_usage_daily (§18.4A) with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, admin_ops_scope policies (§26.13), same-tenant composite foreign keys fk_external_effects_connected_account_id_tenant and fk_api_usage_daily_api_key_id_tenant (§26.11), protect_audit_log_immutability() BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers on audit_events and internal_audit_logs (§26.12), and narrow per-role grants

Compiled DiagnosticsService Protobuf contract (protos/creativanta/admin/v1/diagnostics.proto) and 4-target generated artifacts (Go, Go Connect, TypeScript ES, Dart/Flutter gRPC) for GetOverview, GetHealthGrid, ListIssues, RunFullCheck, and ExecuteRepairStep

Transactional Outbox & Consumer Inbox runtime (apps/api/internal/outbox) implementing canonical queue specs, OutboxPoller with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED 30s leases and lease-owner verification on MarkPublished, ConsumerWorker with XREADGROUP + 60s XAUTOCLAIM recovery and consumer_inbox deduplication before XACK, live actor/approval re-verification before execution, 3-state provider CircuitBreaker, and FairWorkspaceScheduler

External Effects Guard, Webhook Deduplication, and DLQ Manager (apps/api/internal/outbox) enforcing that unresolved ('unknown' or 'submitted') external effects are never blindly retried or replayed from DLQ without reconciliation proof, inbound webhook deduplication via (provider, idempotency_key) and (workspace_id, consumer_name, event_id), outbound S24 webhook sanitization/HMAC-SHA256 signing/100-failure auto-suspension, and OPS-2026-02 DLQ retention protection

Workspace DiagnosticsService handler (apps/api/internal/diagnostics) enforcing RBAC (diagnostics:read and workspace:settings:manage), RULE-M23-A04 user-facing message sanitization, idempotency replay/conflict checks, and the 4-step Guided Repair Wizard (Verify -> Diagnose -> Fix -> Confirm) reconciling unknown external effects
Web Diagnostics Center (/settings/diagnostics, W125) and Mobile Diagnostics Screen (M059) with unit and widget tests
verified_sub_slices: Kill before/after outbox lease commit, after XADD before MarkPublished, before consumer DB commit, and after consumer DB commit before XACK verified to produce strictly 1 domain side effect (TestKillBeforeAndAfterOutboxLeaseAndConsumerCommitAndAck)
20 concurrent duplicate inbound webhooks verified to produce strictly 1 domain effect (TestDuplicateWebhookHasStrictlyOneEffect)

Unresolved ('unknown'/'submitted') external effects verified to block automatic retry and manual DLQ replay until reconciled with proof, while OPS-2026-02 protects unresolved and financial DLQ items from 30-day purge (TestUnresolvedExternalEffectNeverBlindlyRetried)
Live actor/permission revocation before queued message execution aborts execution and records an immutable audit event (TestConsumerLiveAuthRevocationAbortsQueuedEffectAndAudits)

DiagnosticsService RBAC, cross-tenant isolation, RULE-M23-A04 SQL/token sanitization, and 4-step Guided Repair Wizard reconciliation verified (TestRuleM23A04SanitizationAndRepairWizardReconcilesUnknownExternalEffect)
31 Up and 12 Down SQL statements in 00002_p0_05_outbox_inbox_external_effects.sql validated by pglast PostgreSQL AST parser and static contract validator

checks.command: python tooling/build_plan.py && python -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v
cd apps/api && go mod verify && go vet ./...

remaining_scope: CI PostgreSQL 17.10 live execution of TestPostgresLiveOutboxInboxAndExternalEffects via tooling/ci/check_identity.sh (no local PostgreSQL daemon in worker container)
Live Redis Streams (Dragonfly) broker adapter wiring and production HTTP/Connect listener mounting in P0-08/P0-09
Independent GitHub Actions CI green run and security review before ACCEPTED status
decisions: Created canonical Goose SQL migration 00002_p0_05_outbox_inbox_external_effects.sql installing consumer_inbox, external_effects, diagnostics_records, dead_letter_queue, background_jobs, and api_usage_daily with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, composite same-tenant FKs (§26.11), protect_audit_log_immutability() triggers on audit_events and internal_audit_logs (§26.12), and narrow role grants.

Implemented apps/api/internal/outbox with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED 30-second outbox poller leases, conditional MarkPublished lease-owner checks, XREADGROUP + 60-second XAUTOCLAIM PEL recovery, atomic consumer_inbox deduplication before XACK, and live actor/approval re-verification before execution.

Implemented ExternalEffectGuard and DLQManager so operations in 'unknown' or 'submitted' state are never blindly retried or replayed from DLQ without reconciliation proof, and OPS-2026-02 protects unresolved and financial DLQ items from 30-day purge.

Implemented M23 DiagnosticsService ConnectRPC handler (apps/api/internal/diagnostics) enforcing RBAC (diagnostics:read and workspace:settings:manage), RULE-M23-A04 user-facing sanitization, and the 4-step Guided Repair Wizard (Verify -> Diagnose -> Fix -> Confirm) across Web (/settings/diagnostics, W125) and Mobile (M059).

Fixed server-side context deadline/cancellation error mapping in apps/api/internal/transportfixture/server.go so context.DeadlineExceeded maps to connect.CodeDeadlineExceeded (gRPC status 4) rather than connect.CodeUnknown (gRPC status 2) when server-side grpc-timeout fires concurrently with client-side deadline timers.
notes: P0-05 implementation and all local static/unit/race/web/mobile/proto/transport checks are complete (LOCAL_IMPLEMENTED). Live PostgreSQL 17.10 execution of TestPostgresLiveOutboxInboxAndExternalEffects is wired into tooling/ci/check_identity.sh for GitHub Actions CI.
